intro: For homes that need smart design, Brawn delivers. With sleek black glass, a handy storage shelf & a size that fits just right, it balances style with everyday practicality.

features.title: Sleek glass top for easy elegance
features.text: The tempered glass top adds modern shine to your space, while resisting stains & scratches for everyday ease.

features.title: Built-in shelf for handy storage
features.text: A lower shelf keeps cutlery, tableware or décor within reach, so your table stays clear & your meals stress-free.

features.title: Sturdy metal base for lasting support
features.text: Our powder-coated metal legs offer durable support, ensuring the table stands strong through daily use & big gatherings.

features.title: Compact design for urban homes
features.text: Designed to maximise space, Brawn fits beautifully into apartments & smaller dining rooms without compromising comfort.

features.title: Stylish black finish that pairs easily
features.text: The rich black finish complements a wide range of interior styles — from modern minimal to bold & eclectic.

features.title: Perfect size for family meals
features.text: With room for six,our dining table set is ideal for everything from casual breakfasts to weekend dinners with friends & family.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Brawn 6-Seater Tempered Glass Rectangular Dining Set
